Incidents Bot: INCIDENT detected: spike in 5xx on /v1/embeddings in eu-west1 (rate 48/min). severity: P1. PagerDuty alert routed to #incidents. https://metrics.redwood/example/embed-5xx
PagerDuty: Triggered oncall Aisha K (eu).
Aisha K: seeing it in the dashboard, almost all 5xx are from embed requests starting 09:02 UTC.
Aisha K: quick check — error body shows 'incompatible-variant' and 'schema-mismatch' responses from runtime.
Ben S: I can see logs:
```
ERROR runtime: route=embed-service request_id=abc123 model_variant=chat-instruct-v2026 pinned=true fallback_used=true error=incompatible_input_type
stack: runtime/handler.go:452
```
Ben S: Looks like embed route is being routed to a chat/instruct variant (chat-instruct-v2026) via fallback.
Carol R: That matches a recent alias pin change — ops deployed a pin of alias "cust-eu-embed" to version v2026 yesterday for canary, but v2026 is an instruct/chat-only build (no embeddings).
Aisha K: Paging @carol_r can you confirm who pushed that pin?
Carol R: yep that was me to validate a small instruct change for a different customer, I forgot the variant lacked embed export. My bad. :grimacing:
Ben S: Impact: embed requests get routed -> pinned variant -> runtime detects incompatible signature -> fallback kicks to best-effort chat variant -> chat runtime returns structured chat tokens -> client SDK fails with 500. Also we have region fallback loop: eu tries local pinned, then fails to fallback to us-central cluster that also has a pinned alias mismatch, causing increased latency and retries.
Dave O: Observed loop: routing policy tried eu -> us-west -> eu (alias anchor swap) because alias mapping was inconsistent across regions. Traffic bouncing increased RTT and tokenization errors.
Aisha K: Mitigation options: 1) Unpin alias immediately 2) Disable fallback from embed-route to chat variants 3) Route embeds to previous compatible version (v2025-embed) 4) Apply regional circuit-breaker to stop cross-region failover.
Ben S: I recommend unpin + route override as fastest. I'll prepare a redwoodctl command.
Ben S: `redwoodctl alias unpin --alias cust-eu-embed --region eu-west1`
Carol R: I'll run the unpin now.
Carol R: (running) 
```
$ redwoodctl alias unpin --alias cust-eu-embed --region eu-west1
Unpinned alias cust-eu-embed -> success (request queued)
```
Carol R: Done. Also pushing a temporary routing rule to force embed interface to v2025-embed as emergency sticky: `redwoodctl routing override --route /v1/embeddings --target v2025-embed --duration 30m --region eu-west1`
Ben S: Adding a safety change: disable cross-variant fallback for embed routes in eu: `redwoodctl routing set-policy --route /v1/embeddings --allow_variant_mismatch=false --region eu-west1`
Aisha K: I applied the circuit-breaker to prevent region failover: `redwoodctl routing set-circuit --route /v1/embeddings --max-failures=5 --window=60s --region eu-west1`
PagerDuty: Acknowledged by Aisha K.
Ben S: Post-unpin metrics show 5xx rate dropped from 48/min to 4/min within 2 mins, latency back to baseline ~120ms.
Aisha K: Customer impact summary for ops notes: 3 paying customers saw intermittent 500s for ~9 minutes. No data exfil or laters. CS notified.
Carol R: I notified the PM and the relevant customer leads. Sending an email template to CS: "We're investigating embed failures in eu-west1; workaround applied; we'll follow up with root cause."
Dave O: Confirmed no persistent region loop now. Traces show no cross-region retries after circuit-breaker applied.
Ben S: Quick safety post: we'll add a deployment guard: block alias pins if the target variant doesn't expose required interfaces (embeddings/gen/chat). I'll open a follow-up ticket.
Aisha K: Handoff to Ben S for remediation and postmortem. I'm going off-call in 25m. Ben, please take next steps and keep incident in #incidents as you work.
Ben S: Taking over. Next steps: 1) run alias consistency check across regions `redwoodctl alias verify --alias cust-eu-embed --all-regions` 2) add schema validation to alias pinning flow 3) coordinate outreach to affected customers with CS 4) add an automated rollback if pinned variant reports incompatible-interface during health checks.
Ben S: Running alias verification now.
Ben S: `alias verify` shows pins were only set in eu-west1 (we're good) but stale anchored alias mapping in us-west was shadowing during fallback. I'll clear the shadow map.
Carol R: Will add notes to the change log and open PR for pinning guard.
Aisha K: Thanks team. Will prepare an incident report template with timelines.
Ben S: Estimated impact: 3 customers, ~9 minutes of partial failures, no billing anomalies detected. We'll classify as sev-2 in postmortem but P1 on call.
Dave O: Action item for eng-runtime: add a strict-compatibility check in the router before accepting fallback and avoid fallback when interface mismatch is detected.
Carol R: Filing PRs: #devops/guard-pin, #runtime/fallback-strictness.
Ben S: I'll update the incident ticket and ping legal if customers request contractual impact.
Incidents Bot: Incident resolved (mitigations applied). Please file postmortem within 48h and tag #oncall, #runtime. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embed-fallback#postmortem
Aisha K: Thanks all. Leaving notes in pager.
Ben S: (after 30m) Verified metrics stable. Will drive postmortem.
Carol R: Again, sorry for the oversight. Will be more careful with variant compatibility next time.
Ben S: Thanks — blameless and constructive postmortem incoming.
